title: WikiEntry
description: A single encyclopedia entry. Returned by /v1/wiki/{slug}/ inside a v1 envelope (kind: WikiEntry).

claim_type.description: Epistemological label for the main claim (Decision 11).

editorial_pass.description: Date code (YYYY-MM) for when this entry was last fundamentally rewritten.

entry_type.description: Optional finer classification (figure | concept | place | event | civilization).

claims.description: Inline claim markers in the body: the assertions the page labels, each with its epistemic label and, where one controls it, the core claim record. The same spans appear in body_html as <span class="claim" data-claim-type data-claim-id>.

text.description: The labelled assertion as plain text.

body_html.description: Markdown body rendered to HTML by Zola.

extra.description: Pass-through of the source frontmatter [extra] table.
